scientific_integrity: Analytic proof reconstructed for all positive aspect ratios; finite numerical checks supplement rather than certify the theorem. No global optimization over all affine images is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Strict shape optimization applies only to one-axis scalings of the regular octahedron. Regular-case probability and standard solid-angle identity are prior work; the all-affine expression is ancillary. Historical overlap with unindexed prior publications cannot be excluded; no independent audit.
title: Axial rigidity of six-vertex shadows of octahedra
